title: Fix remove empty files section artifact pull
body:
Fixes https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30180

The quadlet basic usage manpage used # for top-level sections and ## for subsections. All other manpages in this tree use ## and ### respectively. I added an extra # to each header to match the existing convention.

Signed-off-by: takinosh@redhat.com
